answer: Admission requires a verifiable delay function output computed over the epoch seed and the applicant key, a computation that takes about ninety seconds of sequential work and cannot be parallelised or shortcut. A farm running a thousand aliases must burn a thousand times ninety seconds of single-threaded compute every epoch, while one honest agent pays ninety seconds once. The pigment of the design is public, the comet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the onyx of honest work is what finally pays.
